structured_output.text:
The batch has 8 runs (r01–r08), and all 8 were accepted. None are flagged and all 8 are cleared.
- All three final checks pass on every run: rigid-body invariance 0.54–0.78 against a threshold of 2.0 %/h, closure 0.13–0.20 against 1.0 px/h, and plane sections 1.19–1.39 against 3.25 %/h. No run kept a remedy, no run rolled back, and no run used the width-free ratio.
- The large |z| values come from a batch MAD close to zero, not from differences in the profiles. In r02 and r04 the flank-difference peak sits at 410 µm instead of 421 µm, and in r03 and r07 the growth zone is 695 µm instead of 684 µm. Each is a single grid step. The REGR peak in r02 and r04 is only 0.04 %/h higher.
- r08's REGR peak has z = -90, but the gap is only 1.34 %/h (51.68 against the batch median of 53.02, about 2.5 % lower). Its peak position, growth-zone length and flank difference match the batch. It ran at stride 1, so a frame-stride change can't have rescaled it. I read it as a slightly slower-growing root, not a fault.
- No runs were flagged, so there is nothing in common to report. The centre-strain-rate (REGR) and curvature-rate profiles are consistent across the batch.
